description: This PHP source file defines the class DeployedMetaDataImplementation, which handles loading, saving, and deploying layout and view definitions for modules in the SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM extension). It implements methods for file management, layout manipulation, and module-specific variable replacements, acting as a bridge for handling deployed metadata configurations within the module builder environment.

classes.name: DeployedMetaDataImplementation
classes.description: Class responsible for managing loaded, saved, and deployed module metadata layouts for SuiteCRM modules. It handles file path resolution, layout merging, variable replacement, and cache clearing after deployment, providing a bridge pattern implementation for module view metadata.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the file path for a given view, module, package, and metadata type location.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided layout definitions to a working file and updates the layout version history.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Finalizes and publishes the layout definitions by moving them from the working directory to the custom directory and clearing the cache for immediate application.

methods.name: getModuleDir
methods.description: Returns the module directory associated with this metadata implementation.
